title: Kenyan Curry Chickpea Tacos
description: A flavorful twist on traditional tacos, featuring Kenyan-inspired curry and wholesome chickpeas in a crispy Mexican taco shell. Serve with your favorite toppings.

ingredients.name: wholesome oil
ingredients.notes: such as avocado or grapeseed oil

instructions: Heat the wholesome oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the Kenyan curry and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and winey vinegar, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the chickpeas are coated in the curry sauce.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the chickpea curry mixture onto a tortilla and topping with your favorite toppings.
